csv_project_name: DB For Saline County Engineering Building Renovation
csv_scope_of_work: Saline County, Kansas ( County ) is soliciting Statements of Qualifications from qualified Design-Build teams to provide progressive design-build services for the renovation and modernization of the Saline County Engineering Building located at 3424 Airport Road, Salina, Kansas. The selected Design-Build Entity shall provide architectural, engineering, preconstruction, estimating, scheduling, and construction services necessary to complete the project. Saline County intends to renovate and modernize the facility to improve: ADA accessibility compliance; interior functionality and workspace efficiency; building systems and finishes; structural deficiencies associated with the east addition; long-term operational flexibility for potential future County departmental use.
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Design Build/Developer, Rehabilitation & Refurbishment, Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Construction/Project Management, Cost Estimating, Value Engineering
